effects.name: Dig Deep
effects.desc: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing. Ignore the effects of Exhaustion levels below 6. 10 minutes.

effects.text: Recharges on a Long Rest. You may instead gain 1 level of Exhaustion (no action required) to restore this use immediately — just run `!cc reset "Dig Deep"` and apply the exhaustion.
